column5: Requirement
The system shall allow a user to access, create, edit, or revise a document in Enlil
The system shall clearly indicate the state of the document being viewed

The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page for the documents list: Document ID, 
Revision (major only), 
Document Title, 
Document Type, 
Document Owner, 
the associated AR ID, 
Document Status, and 
Effective Date 
(this list defines content, not column header names)
The system should provide a mechanism to export the Document List (e.g. to a .csv format)
The system shall only display documents in the documents list (e.g. records can be found in their respective modules or in the records list)
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed Document List for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
The system shall default the Document List filter to display released documents when starting a new Enlil session
The system shall maintain Document List filter settings during an Enlil session when navigating away from and back to the Document List landing page
The system shall default to the Document List being sorted by most recent edited first
The system shall provide a mechanism to clear all Document List filters
The system shall display the number of documents displayed that match the filter settings
The system shall allow the user to open a document from within the Document List
The system should display the description of the document when the mouse hovers over the document title in the Document List
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to create a document from the Document List landing page
The system shall allow a user to revise a document that is in the Released state

The system shall provide the following editable document attributes when creating or revising a document: 
Document Title
Document Description
Document Type
Document Revision Stage
Reference
Training Required
Attachments
Users (document access privileges)
Groups (document access privileges) 
Document Owner Assignment)
The system shall allow the user to edit document ID, when creating a document.
The system shall allow the document owner to add one or more references to a document in draft state
The system shall allow the document owner to remove references to a document in draft state
The system shall allow the document owner to upload one or more attachments to a document in draft state
The system support attachments of multiple types.
The system shall allow the document owner to upload multiple documents at once
The system shall notify the user if a document upload failure occurs
The system shall allow the document owner to remove uploaded attachments for a document in draft state
The system shall allow the document owner to identify a single attachment as the primary attachment for a document
The system shall allow the document owner to identify any attachment as a redline
The system shall default the training to required, if the particular Document Type requires training in the Document Approval Matrix
The system shall default the training to required, if the  previous revision of the particular document required training
The system shall allow the user to deselect training required,  if the default state was training required
The system shall default user/group access to Everyone for new documents
The system shall automatically generate and display a document number when a document is created based on the system configuration for the particular Document Type
The system shall automatically set the document status as Draft when creating or revising a document
The system shall allow the document owner to change document ownership to another user
The system shall allow the document owner to cancel the document draft.  A confirmation dialog is required.
The system shall maintain a history of attribute changes

The system shall allow the user to select the type of revision change, options include next revision, upgrade revision state, administrative, or obsolete, when revising a document and if the option is applicable.
The system shall require a password for a user to access attachments of documents if the document is in Obsolete state
The system shall require a password for a user to access redlines of documents if the document is not in draft state
The system shall allow the user to create a Document Type
The system shall support multiple Document Types as needed by the customer
The system shall allow the user to define a Document Type as QMS or non-QMS. QMS default access everyone and Non-QMS default access only owner
The system shall allow the user to assign a document prefix to a Document Type at the time of creation of the Document Type
The system shall support a sequential numbering by company or by prefix for each Document Type. A starting number will be set per document type.
The system shall support multiple Document Types to share the same prefix. All documents sharing the same prefix shall share sequential numbering system
The system shall maintain a descriptive name for every Document Type
The system shall allow the user to assign a Document Type to an Enlil Document Class
When viewing the Document List, only Document Types defined as Enlil Document Class of Document shall be visible
The Document Approval Matrix shall be enforced for managing approvals to all Enlil Document Classes and Admin changes to POs

For Document Types assigned to an Enlil Document Class of Document, the system shall include the Document Type in the Document List, and utilizes the Document Approval Matrix to manage changes/approvals
For items with an Enlil Document Class of Dynamic Form, the system shall include these Document Types as selectable items when creating custom forms
For items with an Enlil Document Class of PI, the system shall allow addition of these Document Types as process instructions on electronic LHR's
For items with an Enlil Document Class of PO, the system shall display these Document Types on the PO List, and utilize PO approval matrix to manage changes/approvals
The system shall only display the major revision of a document, except for in the revision history of the document
The system shall support the creation of roles (e.g.: QA, R&D, RA…etc.)
The system shall allow the assignment of user groups to roles and users to roles
The system shall allow the user to assign approval requirements per role for each Document Type
The system shall allow separate assignment of approval requirements for a 2-level document system with revision types: Numeric and Alpha
The system shall allow the assignment of approval requirements for a Admin Revision change
The system shall allow users to create and submit approval requests for approval/obsolescence of documents.
The system shall automatically issue a unique approval request ID when a new change request is initiated
The system shall support the customer to define one or more custom forms to be used for approval requests

The system shall support addition of one or more implementation tasks to the AR form, including a task title, task description, task assignment to user, due data, and status tracking, that are required to complete before an AR is closed

The system shall automatically maintain the status of a change request:
Draft - the default state when created
In Review - the state where the change request is in review by the approvers
Approved - the state where the change request has been approved by all reviewers
Implementation - the state where the change request has pending Implementation Task(s)
Closed - the state when an approved change request has been fully implemented by doc control

The system shall automatically update the status attribute of all documents/parts on the approval request when the state of the approval request changes:
Pending Change when the AR is in Draft State
In Review when the AR is in In Review State
Approved when the AR is in Approved State 
Approved when the AR is in Implementation State
Released when the AR is in Closed State

The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page for the approvals list: 
AR ID, 
AR Title, 
AR Owner, and 
AR  State (e.g. this list defines content, not column header names)
The system shall only display document approval requests in the approval requests list (e.g. approvals for other items like PO's can be found in their respective modules)
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed approval request list for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
The system shall default the approval request list filter to display AR's with latest edited IN_REVIEW displaying on top when starting a new Enlil session
The system shall maintain approval request list filter settings during an Enlil session when navigating away from and back to the approval request list landing page
The system shall default to the approval request list being sorted by most recent edited first
The system shall provide a mechanism to clear all approval request list filters
The system shall display the number of approval requests displayed that match the filter settings
The system shall allow the user to open an AR from the AR list
The system should display the AR description when the mouse hovers over the AR title in the approval request list
The system shall allow the originator to edit the approval request and any documents associated with the approval request only while it is in draft or rejected states
The system shall prevent the addition of documents that are already included on another approval request
The system shall determine the approver requirements based on the document approval matrix for all documents contained on an AR.
The system shall enforce approval requirements prior to document release if the Document Type requires e-signature. If not met, an exception shall be visible
The system shall allow the owner of an AR to withdraw an AR that is in In Review State
For "no e-signature required" documents, approvals shall be enforced based on the users invited to approve the document by the document owner.
The system shall provide a mechanism for electronic approvals (e.g. PO's, change requests, training forms, NCMR, CAPA, user profiles)
The system shall require the user to enter their user password when approving or rejecting an approval request that is assigned to them
The system shall allow the owner of an AR to change an approver on the AR to another user, provided that user meets the criteria of the approval matrix
The system shall automatically change the status of a document to "Released" when the AR is approved and the effective date is met
The system shall automatically change the status of an AR to "Closed", when all document(s) have been Released (once the effective date is met) and all implementation task(s) have been closed
The system shall provide the  user the ability to set the Effective Date on an Express AR if there are no pending actions
The system shall record (audit trail) the date and timestamp for approval and rejections by a user
The system shall record (audit trail) the date and timestamp for AR closure (only when the system verifies that the AR is Closed)

The system shall allow the user to create custom forms, for the purpose of creating quality system records.  (e.g. forms for lot history, equipment calibration and maintenance, supplier management, etc.)

The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page for the records list: 
ID, 
Revision, 
State, 
Title, 
Form ID, 
Owner, 
Released Date and 
Form ID 
(this list defines content, not column header names)
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed Record List for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
The system shall allow the user to open a record from within the Records List
The system shall provide a mechanism for the user to create a record from the Records List landing page
The system shall provide the ability to add approvals fields within the Form
The system shall allow the user to define whether form approvals (Inline Approvals) are blocking (required before performing subsequent sections)
The system shall maintain an audit trail of changes to records, including the user making the change, the date and time of the change, and identification of the content that was changed.
The system shall record (audit trail) the date and timestamp for approval and rejections (if applicable) of a record by a user
The system shall create new records at numeric revision stage for forms that include Inline Approval
The system shall create new records at the alpha revision stage for forms that do not include inline approval
The system shall create a new revision for every inline approval
The system shall indicate that a section of the form has been modified after approval, for forms that include Inline Approval
The system shall create and upgrade the revision stage to Alpha when all inline approvals for a form have been recorded - close and finalize is needed
The system shall allow the owner for updates to the record in parallel with the approval process for forms that include Inline Approval

If a record section is edited after approval, the record has been subsequently updated during the approval process, if the record is rejected, the updates made to the record since submission are copied into the record

If a record is submitted for approval of a particular section, and edits are made to another section, once the record is approved, the updates made to the record are copied into the new draft of the record, for forms that include Inline Approval
The system shall only display the major revision of a record, except for in the revision history of the record
The system shall allow the user to update a record after alpha release  (inline or regular) and follow the  Document Approval Matrix to manage approvals
For Document Types assigned to an Enlil Document Class of Record, the system shall include the Document Type in the Records List
The system should allow the user to Void a record.

The system shall display the following default columns on the landing page of the PO module: 
PO#, 
Revision (major only), 
PO status, 
Supplier, 
Part Number, 
Amount, 
Requestor  
Issue Date
PO State
The system should provide a mechanism to export the PO database from the landing page
The system shall allow the user to filter the displayed PO's for each of the columns displayed on the landing page
The system shall default to most recently edited Open PO's displayed when starting a new Enlil session
The system shall maintain PO filter settings during an Enlil session when navigating away from and back to the landing page
The system shall default to the PO list being sorted by most recent first
The system shall provide a mechanism to clear Purchase Order list filters
The system shall display the number of PO's displayed that match the filter settings
The system shall allow the user to open a PO from the PO list
The system should allow the user to access the Title of a Part number on the Purchase Order Landing Page

The system shall allow the user to access a list of the following:
company addresses
GL codes
shipping accounts
Terms
Units

The system shall assign a unique PO number for each PO created
The system shall set the PO state to draft when created
The system shall allow the user to enter a description for the PO

The system shall allow the selection of:
a supplier in the system, 
the shipping address to any of the company address(es)
from a subset of GL Code list
a shipping accounts
the Requestor

The system shall allow the entry of:
a default company address
the "Ordered" date
Terms
The system shall allow the user to specify the selected currency for the entire PO.  The following currencies are supported (USD, EURO, BRITISH POUND, Canadian Dollar and Australian Dollar)
The system shall display a source website from where the exchange rate was extracted, the currency exchange rate and the date that was used to estimate the USD value of the PO
The system shall allow the user to upload attachment(s) (e.g.: quotation and any other necessary attachments…etc.)
The system shall allow the user to enter multiple line items (to purchase parts or service items).
The system shall allow the user to save a PO in Draft state and complete it at a later time
Each line item added to the PO shall have a unique number identifier
The system shall have all the line item details as optional. Exceptions:  the part number identifier is required, the order date is required

The system shall have the following entries if a "Product" line item was selected: Part Number with Rev (list),  Part Description (text entry), Quantity Ordered (text entry), Units (list), GL Code (list), Date Required (Datepicker), Supplier Part Number (text entry), Unit Price (text entry), Capital Equipment (checkbox), Tax (checkbox)

The system shall have the following entries if a "Service" line item was selected: Service ID (text entry), Description (text entry), Quantity Ordered (text entry), Units (list/text entry), GL Code (list), Date Required (list), Unit Price (text entry),  Tax (checkbox)
The system shall auto calculate the subtotal amount based on the ordered quantity and the unit price
The system shall auto calculate the total amount based on the subtotal, the tax (if applicable) and the shipping cost (if applicable)
The system should default a tax rate and provide a mechanism for the user to be able to modify the tax rate in Enlil
The system shall display the total PO cost in USD using the exchange rate when appropriate
The system shall allow the user to identify the PO State (e.g. Open, Closed, Cancelled…etc.).
The system shall allow the user to submit the PO for approval
The system shall enforce the PO Approval Matrix
The system shall allow the user to select approvers based on the PO Approval Matrix
The system shall set the PO state to Submitted for Approval when submitted for approval
The system shall allow the PO Owner to withdraw a PO that has been routed for approval but is not yet fully approved
The system shall capture the ID of the user(s) approving a PO
The system shall capture the date and time of the approval(s)
The system shall set blank PO state when all approvals are recorded
The system shall set the PO state to Draft when a user rejects the PO
The system shall create a PDF of the PO form with all the PO details and attachments (e.g. prints)
The system shall add terms and conditions requiring notification for all changes in the pdf of the PO form
The system shall allow users to revise a PO
The system shall set the PO status to draft when a new revision is created
The system shall capture the ID of the user and the date and time of the changes
The system shall require reapproval of the PO if the modified total is higher than the previous approval threshold for the approvers
The system shall maintain revision history of the PO
The system shall allow a user to set a PO to the "Cancelled" Status
The system shall allow a user to close a PO

i.Receipt ID

The system shall default to the Receiving record list being sorted by most recent first (by most recent edited)
The system shall provide a mechanism to clear Receiving list filters
The system shall display the number of Receiving Records displayed that match the filter settings
The system shall allow users to receive line items from the Receiving landing page
